translations.web: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
translations.bsb: As it was, the heat consumed me by day and the frost by night, and sleep fled from my eyes.
translations.kjv: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
translations.asv: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from mine eyes.
